topics.name: Grid & Net Zero economics
topics.description: Energy generation, storage, transmission and grid balancing, and the economics and policy of the net-zero transition.
topics.in: Grid-scale batteries, solar/wind/pumped-hydro projects, CfD auctions, energy markets and pricing, grid data analytics (Modo Energy-style), climate-economics data.
topics.out: Consumer EVs, energy-efficiency gadgets, corporate sustainability PR, climate activism.

topics.name: Data Centers / AI / macro
topics.description: The AI industry layer: compute build-out, data centers, chips and silicon, model economics and AI capital markets.
topics.in: Data center construction, chip supply and geopolitics, AI market structure, funding and capex cycles, power constraints on compute.
topics.out: AI tools for development/business (own topic), model benchmarks and product reviews, AI research papers.

topics.name: Applied Life Sciences & Health
topics.description: Therapeutic platforms, biotech scaling, and the etiology of complex chronic illness. Particular interest: ME/CFS and long COVID, multiple sclerosis and Alzheimer's, and new genetic, AI and longevity-related discoveries — but not at the expense of other health-tech innovation.
topics.in: Drug development and clinical research, biotech platforms and scaling, novel therapeutics, ME/CFS and long COVID research, multiple sclerosis and Alzheimer's, genetic/AI/longevity discoveries.
topics.out: Wellness content, NHS operational politics, hospital anecdotes.

topics.name: Geopolitics & Military Strategy
topics.description: Doctrine, defense industrial capacity, great-power competition, and strategic/military analysis.
topics.in: Force structure and doctrine shifts, unmanned/autonomous systems, industrial base capacity, strategic analysis including military history.
topics.out: Partisan politics, current-events punditry without strategic analysis.

topics.name: History (systems-thinking standpoint)
topics.description: History analyzed through systems: logistics, incentives, physical constraints and technology adoption. Particular interest: how geography affects history, and the history of politics and economics.
topics.in: Innovation history (Age of Invention), quantitative/logistical history, how systems and constraints shaped outcomes, geography's role in history, history of politics and economics.
topics.out: Narrative or political history without systems analysis, local nostalgia pieces.
sources: Age of Invention, by Anton Howes

topics.name: Agriculture
topics.description: Farming and food production as systems: net-zero agriculture, agronomy research, and the systems history of agriculture.
topics.in: Land use and agronomy research, agricultural policy, historical food systems, farm-environment interaction.
topics.out: Home cooking, restaurant reviews, food science for chefs.

topics.name: Infrastructure & Policy (built environment)
topics.description: Physical infrastructure and the built environment: construction costs, engineering structures, buildings and civil works, and their policy.
topics.in: Construction economics (Construction Physics), project delivery, engineering structures, urban form, infrastructure policy.
topics.out: Transport operations and transit (own topic), energy generation (own topic).

topics.name: Transit
topics.description: Public transit, roads and self-driving vehicles, and transport policy.
topics.in: Rail/bus/freight operations and investment, AV regulation and rollout, congestion pricing, transport innovation (London Reconnections-style).
topics.out: Vehicle tech reviews, driving culture, EV consumer content.

topics.name: Industry, Manufacturing & Policy
topics.description: Industrial production and manufacturing capability, supply chains, and industrial policy.
topics.in: High-mix manufacturing, reshoring and industrial base, energy-intensive industry, SMRs and heavy industry, defense industrial capacity (overlaps Geopolitics).

topics.name: Business, Risk & Finance
topics.description: Markets, corporate strategy, risk and macro-finance.
topics.in: Capital allocation, market structure, economic analysis (Freakonomics-style), strategy (Rumelt), macro-finance.
topics.out: Personal finance advice, stock tips, career advice.

topics.name: Leadership / Management
topics.description: Leading teams and organizations: management practice, organizational design, and product/engineering leadership.
topics.in: Coaching and management practice, org design, scaling engineering and product teams, leadership thinking.
sources: Oren Ellenbogen's Thoughts, stories and ideas

topics.name: Innovation in Government
topics.description: Public-sector digital transformation: government service design, platforms, and policy innovation.
topics.in: Government as a Platform, Policy Lab, user research in government, DWP/HMRC digital teams, gov design systems.

topics.name: AI Tooling for Development & Business
topics.description: AI tools applied to software development and business workflows — the application layer, not the industry. Particular interest: open-source tools and open-weights models, plus frontier developments.
topics.in: AI coding assistants, AI agents for business, tool landscape and practical adoption, open-source tools and open-weights models, frontier AI tooling.
topics.out: AI industry economics and capex (own topic), model research, benchmarks.
